scripts.dev:mobile: echo "Starting development server for mobile testing..." && echo "Your local IP address:" && ipconfig | findstr "IPv4" && echo "Use the IP address above with port 5173 (e.g., https://192.168.1.100:5173)" && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:mobile:https: node generate-ssl.js && echo "Starting HTTPS development server for mobile testing..." && echo "Your local IP address:" && ipconfig | findstr "IPv4" && echo "Use the IP address above with port 5173 (e.g., https://192.168.1.100:5173)" && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.dev:mobile:ngrok: echo "Starting development server with ngrok tunnel..." && echo "1. Start the dev server: npm run dev" && echo "2. In another terminal, run: npx ngrok http 5173" && echo "3. Use the HTTPS URL from ngrok on your mobile device" && vite --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview
